name: foxmath
summary: Minimalist CLI & library for number theory and cryptography: Dixon & Lenstra ECM factoring, Pollard p-1, Lucas-Lehmer Mersenne tests, Fermat factor, RSA & Diffie-Hellman cryptosystems, BSGS discrete log, arithmetic functions (mu, sigma, tau), Jacobi symbol, Tonelli-Shanks, elliptic curves, CRT, and continued fractions.
